approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: Autodesk and Procore official RFI documentation exposes a Status field alongside Question and Official Response content.
Recognize only exact known RFI status values under an exact Status or RFI Status label; ordinary prose and status metadata remain neutral.
RFI status is reviewer metadata only: it must not manufacture a Question/Response role, contractual effect or latest-version precedence.
Conflicting explicit statuses remain ambiguous; 625 Python, 24 UI and 11 deploy tests passed using synthetic offline documents only.
title: Preserve exact RFI workflow status
objective: Preserve exact known RFI statuses across TXT, PDF and Email evidence plus the reviewer index without deriving roles, authority or precedence from status text.
